Author: Anomek
Name: AnoMech
Punchline: Another FFXIV mechanics simulator. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party.

Author: shifusen329
Name: Raid Replay
Punchline: Replay and analyze raid pulls from your ACT network logs.
Description:
Reconstructs every pull from ACT network logs: arena map, waymarks, player positions and facing, boss casts and AoE telegraphs, towers, tethers, head markers and deaths, with a scrubbable timeline. Watches the live log and explains each wipe right after it happens: root cause, who was where, and where they should have been.

Alpha: requires ACT with the FFXIV plugin writing network logs (default folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\Advanced Combat Tracker\FFXIVLogs). /aar opens the after-action report, /raidreplay the replay window. The Feedback button sends a report to the developer, with player names replaced, only when you press Send.
Changelog: 0.0.9 (alpha): the report groups its incidents by prog point (Dancing Mad: the wtfdig.info guide's sections, from Graven 1: Fire + Ice to Forsaken (Enrage)), with an alert count on each; the root cause's and the collapse's are open, the rest closed, so a mitigation missed early no longer shows as contributing to a later wipe. Logs with Dancing Mad pulls are indexed again once. 0.0.8 (alpha): pull list grouped by entry into a duty (time limit used, pulls, best boss HP) and it scrolls through every pull again; a short confetti blames the holder or the role-mate who stayed out, whichever was off their spot, never the players who took it; a death to Indulgent Will goes to whoever left arrows off their spots (it hits harder for each one); a Spell's Trouble cone sent to the wrong player blames its holder, and Spell's Trouble attacks are named as players see them. Re-indexes your logs once. 0.0.7 (alpha): Boss tab in the replay window (HP and every status on the boss: who applied it, stacks, time left), stack/spread/cone head-marker icons on the map, refreshed statuses keep the right timer, and a crash that left some Tele-trouncing pulls without a report. 0.0.6 (alpha): Feedback button in the after-action report (anonymized, sent only when you press Send), DPS tab in the replay window, and the report opens by itself only in raids, trials and ultimates (choose which in Settings). 0.0.5 (alpha): copies from the after-action report paste into the game's chat as one line (right-click for the full text), fewer copy buttons, plugin icon. 0.0.4 (alpha): new 'Out of position' and 'Incorrect baiting' verdicts (a rock, Wave Cannon line, spread or Past's/Future's End bait hitting someone blames whoever was off their spot), towers follow the strat (Forsaken soak order AAABBBBA, Wave Cannon role towers; dead soakers are traced, never replaced by a bystander), jumping off to end a lost pull is no longer a reset and resets are never the verdict, Esc closes the report, Copy recap per incident, report tables wrap, ATTRIBUTION.md rulebook. 0.0.3 (alpha): the rest of Dancing Mad (Ultimate) - late P3, P4 and P5 (sections, attack shapes, Chaos/Neo Exdeath/P5 Kefka, mitigation sheet through P5, timed from each phase's start), new explanations (black-hole laser through the wrong player, Acceleration Bomb holder), logs without OverlayPlugin lines are read, a role stack the holder walked away from blames the holder, clears no longer get a root cause, tower blame goes to whoever was missing. 0.0.2 (alpha): Dancing Mad Phase 3 through Earthquake (sections, Chaos/Exdeath, crystals, attack shapes, limit-cut numbers, mitigation sheet), P3 wipe explanations (earth crystal double cleanse, Umbra Smash landing on the party), late P2 sections, /rr shortcut, in-game look for Tele-trouncing teleporters, P1 Kefka now drawn, fixes to spread/stack judgement and death recaps. 0.0.1: first test build.

Author: shifusen329
Name: PF Notification
Punchline: Phone alerts when your Party Finder party fills, members join or leave, or a duty pops. Optional remote party chat from your phone.
Description:
Watches your party and sends a notification to your phone through a self-hosted ntfy server when it reaches full size, when members join or leave, and when a Duty Finder queue or roulette pops, so you can step away while recruiting or queueing.
Passive by default: it only observes your own client and never sends anything to the game servers. The one exception is remote party chat, off by default, which posts messages you publish from your phone to party chat on your behalf.
Needs an ntfy topic and access token; set them with /pfnotify. Alpha, for FC members; not intended for the official repository.
Changelog: 0.1.0 (alpha): duty-ready alert when a Duty Finder queue or roulette pops (priority 5 by default, /pfnotify duty on|off), and opt-in remote party chat: messages you publish to your chat topic from your phone are posted to party chat as /p, with guards (no commands, one line, 500 bytes, one every 2 s and 10 a minute, nothing older than 60 s) and a confirmation back to your phone (/pfnotify chat on|off; the plugin token needs read access to the chat topic). The plugin is passive by default; remote chat is the one exception and stays off until you enable it. 0.0.1 (alpha): first test build. A phone notification through ntfy when your party fills (Party Finder and same-world parties), plus join and leave alerts by job (never names). It never fires on entering or leaving a duty, or when you join a full party. Needs an ntfy topic and access token: /pfnotify.
